t: The $(5)Block Access Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). It enables a Matrix to inhibit a player's ability to right-click on a block and access its GUI screen.
$(5)防访问模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块。它使干涉矩阵能够限制玩家对某一方块右键点击并打开其GUI界面的能力。

If an unauthorized player tries to right-click a block or machine located within the action range of an Interdiction Matrix (equipped with the $(5)Block Access Module$()), they will not be permitted to open its GUI. As we would expect, blocks or machines outside the action area can be used normally.
若未授权玩家试图右键点击位于干涉矩阵（配备$(5)防访问模块$()）作用范围内的方块或机器，则无法打开其GUI界面。正如我们所预期的那样，作用区域外的方块或机器仍可正常使用。
